# Upload stool data from curatedMetagenomicData package

```{r include=FALSE}
# Install BiocManager if not already installed
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(version = "3.23")

# Finally, install curatedMetagenomicData
BiocManager::install("curatedMetagenomicData")
```

```{r message = FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(caret)
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
```

### Load stool samples

```{r}
# Filter only stool samples
stool_samples <- sampleMetadata %>%
  filter(body_site == "stool")
```

### Remove duplicates

```{r}
# Removing duplicated sample_id rows
if (any(duplicated(stool_samples$sample_id))) {
  warning("sample_id contains duplicates!")
} else {
  message("All sample_id values are unique.")
}

# All duplicates samples comes from two studies - NielsenHB_2014 has more information (age), so remove samples from LeChatelierE_2013
# Removing 177 sample from original 21030
dup_id = stool_samples$sample_id[duplicated(stool_samples$sample_id)]

dup_rows = stool_samples[stool_samples$sample_id %in% dup_id, ]

lechatelier_dup = dup_rows[dup_rows$study_name == "LeChatelierE_2013", ]

stool_samples = stool_samples[!(stool_samples$sample_id %in% lechatelier_dup$sample_id &
                                  stool_samples$study_name == "LeChatelierE_2013"), ]
rm(dup_rows, lechatelier_dup)
```

### Keep only informative columns

```{r}
# Leave necessary columns
key_cols <- c("study_name", "sample_id", "subject_id", "antibiotics_current_use", "study_condition", "disease", "age", "age_category", "gender", "country",
              "location", "non_westernized", "sequencing_platform", "DNA_extraction_kit", "PMID", "number_reads", "number_bases", "minimum_read_length",
              "median_read_length", "NCBI_accession", "treatment", "infant_age", "pregnant", "BMI")
stool_samples <- stool_samples %>%
  select(all_of(key_cols))
```

## Data exploration

### Studies

```{r}
# Studies
# Count samples per study
study_counts <- table(stool_samples$study_name)

cat("Total studies:", length(study_counts), "\n")
cat("Total samples:", sum(study_counts), "\n")
cat("Mean samples per study:", mean(study_counts), "\n")
cat("Median samples per study:", median(study_counts), "\n")
cat("Range:", range(study_counts), "\n")
cat("Studies with <100 samples:", sum(study_counts < 100), "\n")
cat("Studies with >100 samples:", sum(study_counts > 1000), "\n")

ggplot(as.data.frame(table(stool_samples$study_name)), aes(x = reorder(Var1, -Freq), y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), angle = 90) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Study", y = "Number of samples", title = "Samples per study")
```

### Gender

```{r}
# Gender
gender_table <- as.data.frame(table(stool_samples$gender, useNA = "ifany"))
names(gender_table) <- c("gender", "count")
gender_table$pct <- round(gender_table$count/sum(gender_table$count)*100, 1)

ggplot(gender_table, aes(gender, count)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(count, " (", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.5)

rm(gender_table)
```

### Diseases

```{r}
# Replace all values that start with "melanoma;metastases" with "melanoma;metastases"
stool_samples$disease[grepl("^melanoma;metastases", stool_samples$disease)] <- "melanoma;metastases"
```

### Filter rare diseases

```{r}
# Filter rare diseases
disease_table = as.data.frame(table(stool_samples$disease))
names(disease_table) <- c("disease", "count")
disease_table$pct = round(disease_table$count/sum(disease_table$count)*100, 3)

# Count samples with conditions present less than 0.1%
rare_dis = disease_table[(disease_table$pct < 0.1), ]
cat("Total count samples with diseases appeard less than 0.1%:", sum(rare_dis$count), "\n")
# Filter rare diseases from df
stool_samples = stool_samples[!(stool_samples$disease %in% rare_dis$disease), ]
```

```{r}
# Filter out diseases with < 0.1% before plotting
disease_table <- as.data.frame(table(stool_samples$disease))
names(disease_table) <- c("disease", "count")
disease_table$pct <- round(disease_table$count / sum(disease_table$count) * 100, 1)

# Remove diseases with < 0.1%
disease_table <- disease_table[disease_table$pct >= 0.1, ]

ggplot(disease_table, aes(x = reorder(disease, -count), y = count)) +

            angle = 90, 
            size = 3) +

       title = "Samples per study condition")
```

```{r}
# Age category isn't consistent across studies, therefore divide it as following
stool_samples$age_category = case_when(
  stool_samples$age == 0  ~ "newborn",
  stool_samples$age >= 1 & stool_samples$age < 10 ~ "child",
  stool_samples$age >= 10 & stool_samples$age < 20 ~ "adolescent",
  stool_samples$age >= 20 & stool_samples$age < 60 ~ "adult",
  stool_samples$age >= 60 ~ "senior",
  is.na(stool_samples$age) == TRUE ~ stool_samples$age_category)

```

```{r}
# Age table
age_table <- as.data.frame(table(stool_samples$age))
names(age_table) <- c("age", "count")
age_table$age <- as.numeric(as.character(age_table$age))
age_table$pct <- round(age_table$count / sum(age_table$count) * 100, 1)

# Age category table with age ranges
age_category_table <- stool_samples %>%
  group_by(age_category) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct = round(n() / nrow(stool_samples) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Order of categories
    age_category = factor(age_category, 
                         levels = c("newborn", "child", "adolescent", "adult", "senior"))
  )

age_category_table = age_category_table %>% drop_na() # remove one row with NA sample

# Create the combined plot
ggplot() +
  # Background: Age category bars
  geom_rect(data = age_category_table,
            aes(xmin = min_age - 0.5, 
                xmax = max_age + 0.5,
                ymin = 0, 
                ymax = max(age_table$count) * 1.15,
                fill = age_category),
            alpha = 0.4) +
  # Foreground: Individual age bars
  geom_col(data = age_table,
           aes(x = age, y = count),
           width = 0.9) +
  # Category labels on top
  geom_text(data = age_category_table,
            aes(x = (min_age + max_age) / 2, 
                y = max(age_table$count) * 1.1,
                label = paste0(age_category, "\n(n=", count, ")")),
            size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("newborn" = "#003f5c", 
                               "child" = "#575092", 
                               "adolescent" = "#bb4e99", 
                               "adult" = "#ff5f68", 
                               "senior" = "#ffa600"),
                    guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 107, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 250)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, angle = 90)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", 
       y = "Number of samples", 
       title = "Age distribution with age categories")
ggsave("age_distribution.png", width=2000, height=1000, units = "px")

rm(age_table, disease_table)
```

## Save data

```{r}
save_functional_profiles <- function(metadata, output_file, chunk_size = 100) {
  
  # Get all samples and split into chunks
  sample_ids <- metadata$sample_id
  chunks <- split(sample_ids, ceiling(seq_along(sample_ids) / chunk_size))
  
  # Process first chunk to initialize
  first_chunk <- TRUE
  
  for (chunk_idx in seq_along(chunks)) {
    cat("Processing chunk", chunk_idx, "of", length(chunks), "\n")
    
    chunk_samples <- metadata[metadata$sample_id %in% chunks[[chunk_idx]], ]
    
    chunk_profile <- tryCatch({
      assay(
        returnSamples(
          sampleMetadata = chunk_samples,
          dataType = "pathway_abundance",
          counts = TRUE
        )
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error processing chunk:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (is.null(chunk_profile)) {
      next
    }
    
    if (first_chunk) {
      # Initialize with first chunk
      final_profile <- chunk_profile
      first_chunk <- FALSE
    } else {
      # Merge with existing profile (align rows)
      all_pathways <- union(rownames(final_profile), rownames(chunk_profile))
      
      # Create expanded matrix
      expanded_final <- matrix(0,
                              nrow = length(all_pathways),
                              ncol = ncol(final_profile),
                              dimnames = list(all_pathways, colnames(final_profile)))
      expanded_final[rownames(final_profile), ] <- final_profile
      
      expanded_chunk <- matrix(0,
                              nrow = length(all_pathways),
                              ncol = ncol(chunk_profile),
                              dimnames = list(all_pathways, colnames(chunk_profile)))
      expanded_chunk[rownames(chunk_profile), ] <- chunk_profile
      
      # Combine
      final_profile <- cbind(expanded_final, expanded_chunk)
      
      # Clean up
      rm(expanded_final, expanded_chunk, all_pathways)
      gc()
    }
    
    rm(chunk_profile)
    gc()
  }
  
  # Write final profile
  write.table(
    final_profile,
    file = output_file,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE
  )
  
  rm(final_profile)
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
# Similarly for taxonomical profiles
save_taxonomical_profiles <- function(metadata, output_file, chunk_size = 100) {
  
  sample_ids <- metadata$sample_id
  chunks <- split(sample_ids, ceiling(seq_along(sample_ids) / chunk_size))
  
  first_chunk <- TRUE
  
  for (chunk_idx in seq_along(chunks)) {
    cat("Processing chunk", chunk_idx, "of", length(chunks), "\n")
    
    chunk_samples <- metadata[metadata$sample_id %in% chunks[[chunk_idx]], ]
    
    chunk_profile <- tryCatch({
      assay(
        returnSamples(
          sampleMetadata = chunk_samples,
          dataType = "relative_abundance"
        )
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error processing chunk:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (is.null(chunk_profile)) {
      next
    }
    
    if (first_chunk) {
      final_profile <- chunk_profile
      first_chunk <- FALSE
    } else {
      all_taxa <- union(rownames(final_profile), rownames(chunk_profile))
      
      expanded_final <- matrix(0,
                              nrow = length(all_taxa),
                              ncol = ncol(final_profile),
                              dimnames = list(all_taxa, colnames(final_profile)))
      expanded_final[rownames(final_profile), ] <- final_profile
      
      expanded_chunk <- matrix(0,
                              nrow = length(all_taxa),
                              ncol = ncol(chunk_profile),
                              dimnames = list(all_taxa, colnames(chunk_profile)))
      expanded_chunk[rownames(chunk_profile), ] <- chunk_profile
      
      final_profile <- cbind(expanded_final, expanded_chunk)
      
      rm(expanded_final, expanded_chunk, all_taxa)
      gc()
    }
    
    rm(chunk_profile)
    gc()
  }
  
  write.table(
    final_profile,
    file = output_file,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE
  )
  
  rm(final_profile)
  gc()
}
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Divide samples into train, validation and test sets stratified by health condition
train.index = createDataPartition(stool_samples$disease, p = .6, list = FALSE)
train = stool_samples[train.index, ]
test_val = stool_samples[-train.index, ]

test.index = createDataPartition(test_val$disease, p = .5, list = FALSE)
test = test_val[test.index, ]
val = test_val[-test.index, ]
rm(test_val)
```

```{r message = FALSE}
save_functional_profiles(train, "../data/functions/stratified_by_disease/raw/train.tsv") # 12,502 samples
save_functional_profiles(val,   "../data/functions/stratified_by_disease/raw/val.tsv") # 4,088 samples
save_functional_profiles(test,  "../data/functions/stratified_by_disease/raw/test.tsv") # 4,100 samples
```

```{r message = FALSE}
total_rows <- nrow(stool_samples)

# Divide into 4 even parts
parts <- split(stool_samples, cut(1:total_rows, breaks = 4, labels = FALSE))

# Assign to separate variables
X1 <- parts[[1]]
X2 <- parts[[2]]
X3 <- parts[[3]]
X4 <- parts[[4]]

# Save the functional profiles
save_functional_profiles(X1, "../data/functions/all/raw/X1.tsv")
save_functional_profiles(X2, "../data/functions/all/raw/X2.tsv")
save_functional_profiles(X3, "../data/functions/all/raw/X3.tsv")
save_functional_profiles(X4, "../data/functions/all/raw/X4.tsv")
```
